projects.title: VR LLM Conversational Agent
projects.description: Most VR agents have 3–5 second response latency — long enough to break immersion. I built a conversational agent that hits 1.8s average by parallelizing Gemini 2.5 Flash calls with Google Cloud STT/TTS, caching partial results, and preprocessing audio before transmission.
longDescription: Engineered a real-time VR conversational agent integrating Gemini 2.5 Flash with Google Cloud STT/TTS, achieving average response latency of 1.8s through parallel API calls, caching, and audio preprocessing.

Designed within-subjects experimental study (N=18) evaluating three latency feedback mechanisms (embodied gestures, visual indicators, verbal fillers) on perceived animacy and immersion via Godspeed questionnaire.
Proved via Wilcoxon signed-rank test (p<0.05) that embodied gestures significantly outperform visual loading indicators; co-authored paper submitted to MIT's Presence journal (under review).
projects.paperBadge: Paper under review · MIT Presence journal

projects.title: AI Resume Builder & Interview Prep Tool
projects.description: Tailoring a resume for each role is tedious and opaque. This tool takes your resume and a job description, generates an ATS-optimised version using Gemini 2.5 Flash via streaming API, and surfaces role-specific interview questions by matching your experience against a structured DSA/STAR prep database.
longDescription: Built full-stack AI resume tool with real-time PDF preview and ATS-optimised generation using Next.js SSR and Gemini 2.5 Flash via streaming API.
Integrated Gemini to generate personalised interview questions by cross-referencing uploaded resumes against a structured DSA/STAR prep database, surfacing role-specific preparation gaps.
Implemented Firebase Authentication with Google OAuth for secure user management and session-based access control across the full application.

projects.title: Kelp Forest Semantic Segmentation
projects.description: Kelp forests are a critical ocean ecosystem — detecting them in satellite imagery is hard because atmospheric interference corrupts images unpredictably. I trained a U-Net with EfficientNet-B3 backbone for segmentation and built a streak-detection pipeline to filter corrupted training images before they hurt model accuracy.
longDescription: Achieved Top 100 finish (top 17%) in a DrivenData satellite imagery competition using U-Net with EfficientNet-B3 backbone for kelp forest segmentation in noisy real-world imagery.
Built streak-detection pipeline using an ensemble of CNN classifiers (ResNet, DenseNet) with hard voting to filter atmospherically corrupted training images, achieving F1 score of 0.952.

longDescription: Built automated data pipeline using PRAW to scrape 22,000+ interactions from 19 pregnancy-related subreddits, implementing concurrent scraping with rate limiting and error recovery for 99.5% data completeness.

projects.title: UI Wireframe Generator
projects.description: Explored generative approaches for UI wireframe synthesis from text prompts using RICO dataset (72,000+ UI screens), experimenting with a Cross-Attention GAN (CAGAN) and LLaMA-7B fine-tuned on custom text-UI pairs.
longDescription: Explored generative approaches for UI wireframe synthesis from text prompts using RICO dataset (72,000+ UI screens), experimenting with a Cross-Attention GAN (CAGAN) modified from the SAGAN architecture.

Fine-tuned LLaMA-7B on custom text-UI pairs to translate natural language requirements into structured JSON layouts, achieving best results with LLM-based generation over diffusion models under GPU constraints.
Benchmarked multiple generative architectures (DDPM, Stable Diffusion, StyleGAN, SAGAN, CAGAN, LLaMA) documenting tradeoffs in quality, training stability, and compute for UI generation tasks.
